Chapter 7128: It’S Beginning

Chapter 7128: It’s Beginning

“Boom!” An explosion shook Divine Firmament violently after the duo left the palace.

A shadow loomed above, terrorizing all spectators. Cultivators in the imperial realm and above reacted differently compared to the rest.

They noticed that Skykiller Palace was in the center. The energies resembled a pair of spreading wings.

“The sea of wisdom!” Chongming Immortal Monarch trembled, not ready for the inevitable.

“Still hoping for the best?” Li Qiye asked.

“They have to leave.” His expression darkened.

“Why are you sad when you knew this day would come? The moment you let them take the young birds, you have chosen to accept the divine beasts’ way. These are crocodile tears.” Li Qiye said.

“Am I to do nothing at all?” He asked.

“This is like a crocodile eating all the big fish and sparing the small ones, telling itself that it was being merciful.” Li Qiye said.

“I suppose that’s true...” He was completely dispirited.

“Nonetheless, that still counts as something. Even the smallest act of kindness is worth doing, one shouldn’t refrain from doing good just because the deed is small.” Li Qiye said.

He took a deep breath and nodded, heading back to Chong Firmament.

“Boom!” Meanwhile, Skykiller Palace turned into a fiery sun.

Spectators watched in confusion. Some even prostrated and worshipped the incredible sight.

“The immortal palace is activated to protect us, the might of the divine beasts!” Many were moved to tears.

“We will be saved from the apocalypse!” Someone shouted.

However, the sea of wisdom seemed alive and began to fuse with the palace’s fiery wings, adding a dark and malicious affinity.

The palace served as the central hub of Divine Firmament, the key to its grand momentum. Thus, the fusion dragged all of Divine Firmament into the sea of wisdom. The fiery flames and the dark waves intertwined like the yin and yang.

However, when spectators saw this, they assumed it was a conflict between good and evil. They thought that the dark waves were an evil being ambushing the radiant palace.

“The divine beasts will defeat all evil!” Mortals and cultivators prostrated and prayed fervently.

“They are eternal and will always illuminate our world!” More joined in.

Unfortunately, as the fusion process continued, the sea of wisdom gradually took over Divine Firmament’s grand momentum.

“Buzz.” Grand veins among the twenty-four layers lit up. They contained the essences of this world.

The palace and the sea formed a maelstrom and began sucking worldly essences from the grand veins. Just a tiny bit initially was shocking. Terrains began to change; mountains and palaces were obliterated.

“What?!” Living beings were horrified, thinking that the evil being was winning against the divine beasts.

“Oh, great divine beasts, please protect us!” They placed all their hope on the protectors.

Alas, they had no idea that the divine beasts had been taken to a safe location.

“It’s finally time to pull the net since winter is coming, and they can use the fish.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“It’s really coming.” The monarch could only watch his race treat Divine Firmament as a final meal to survive the calamity.
